cases.input: I'm on the phone with a recruiter about a $120,000 job. If I commute from Leesburg Bypass to Route 28 Monday through Friday, leave at 8 AM, return at 5:30 PM, and plan 240 office days a year, what does the tolled commute do to my income?
cases.actual_output:
### 💼 Tolled commute impact

**Under the middle historical scenario (P50), the $120,000 job leaves an estimated **$73,299.20** after the one-third tax assumption and tolled commute costs.**

- 💰 **Gross annual income:** $120,000.00
- 🧾 **Income after one-third tax assumption:** $80,000.00
- 🚙 **Tolled-segment vehicle cost:** $3,916.80 annually
- 🛣️ **P50 annual toll:** $2,784.00
- 📉 **P50 total annual tolled-commute cost:** $6,700.80
- 💼 **Additional gross salary needed to offset:** $10,051.20

| Scenario | Per office day | Average monthly | Annual | Remaining income |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| P25 — lower historical scenario | $27.92 | $558.40 | $6,700.80 | $73,299.20 |
| P50 — middle historical scenario | $27.92 | $558.40 | $6,700.80 | $73,299.20 |
| P90 — higher historical scenario | $27.92 | $558.40 | $6,700.80 | $73,299.20 |

#### ⚠️ Assumptions and limitations

- This covers only the tolled portions between the validated Leesburg Bypass–Route 28 endpoints; all untolled commute segments are excluded.
- The estimate assumes one-third of gross income goes to taxes; it is not an actual tax calculation.
- Vehicle cost uses **$0.685 per straight-line tolled mile**, a fixed compact-SUV benchmark from [AAA](https://www.ace.aaa.com/automotive/advocacy/cost-of-driving.html), not your individualized vehicle expense.
- It assumes **240 Monday–Friday office days**, with an 8:00 AM outbound trip and a 5:30 PM return.
- The toll evidence covers **60 complete paired commute days from 6/1/2026 through 8/21/2026**, with 100% weekday coverage. It uses current fixed rates, no modeled prices, and a complete historical sample—not a forecast or probability-based prediction.
- The estimate covers **23.83 tolled miles per round trip**, or **5,719.20 annual tolled miles**.

For the recruiter, you may want to:

- Confirm the fixed office days.
- Ask whether arrival and departure times are flexible.
- Ask about direct toll reimbursement.

cases.input: I'm on the phone with a recruiter about a $120,000 job in Tysons. I live near Springfield-Franconia, commute Monday through Friday, leave at 8 AM, return at 5:30 PM, and plan 240 office days a year. What does the tolled commute do to my income?
cases.actual_output:
### 💼 Estimated income impact

**Under the P50 middle historical scenario, your estimated income after the assumed tax and tolled commute is $62,100.80 per year.**

- 💰 **Gross annual income:** $120,000.00
- 🧾 **Income after the one-third tax assumption:** $80,000.00
- 🚙 **Tolled-segment vehicle cost:** $3,799.20 annually
- 🛣️ **P50 annual toll:** $14,100.00
- 📉 **P50 total annual tolled-commute cost:** $17,899.20
- 💼 **Additional gross salary needed to offset:** $26,848.80

| Scenario | Per office day | Average monthly | Annual | Remaining income |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **P25 — lower historical scenario** | $70.68 | $1,413.60 | $16,963.20 | $63,036.80 |
| **P50 — middle historical scenario** | $74.58 | $1,491.60 | $17,899.20 | $62,100.80 |
| **P90 — higher historical scenario** | $81.83 | $1,636.60 | $19,639.20 | $60,360.80 |

#### ⚠️ Assumptions and qualifications

- This estimate covers **only the tolled portion**: straight-line distance between endpoints of validated priced toll-facility legs. It excludes every untolled part of the commute.
- The tool used **23.11 tolled miles per round-trip day**, or **5,546.40 annual miles**.
- It assumes **one-third of gross income goes to taxes**; this is not an actual tax calculation.
- Vehicle cost uses **$0.685 per straight-line tolled mile**, a fixed compact-SUV benchmark from [AAA](https://www.ace.aaa.com/automotive/advocacy/cost-of-driving.html), not your individualized vehicle expense.
- The toll estimate uses recent historical evidence from **6/1/2026–8/21/2026**, with **83.3% coverage** and **50 complete round-trip pairs**. The sample is partial, prices are modeled, and current fixed rates are not used. These are annualized historical daily scenarios—not forecasts or probabilities.

For your recruiter, you may want to:

- Confirm the fixed office days.
- Ask about flexible arrival or departure times.
- Ask whether tolls are reimbursed directly.
